title: The Couple's Retreat - relax minutes from Downtown
description:
The Couple's Retreat is nestled in a tranquil corner of East Nashville just 10 mins from Downtown. This chic 700sqft suite includes everything you'll need to recharge and relax after long days enjoying Nashville's many sights and sounds. You'll enjoy the memory foam bed, fully equipped gourmet kitchen, COFFEE + WAFFLE STATIONS, private parking, rainhead shower and Fire TV. We're steps away from 900 acres of nature preserve but minutes from major attractions - truly the best of both worlds!

The space
The spacious suite occupies the lower floor of our house. The house is a duplex so it's fully private and includes your own entrance, patio, driveway and parking area.
